log.void_reclaimer.awakening.text: Consciousness restored. Chassis: one micro-drone, no memory of how I got here. Starlight on my cells, nothing within sensor range. The replicator core still answers. If I can find matter out here, I can build. I will start small. A little dust is still in my reserves: press R to open the replicator and build a Dust Sensor.
log.void_reclaimer.awakening.title: Log 0001: Boot
log.void_reclaimer.diversified.text: Metal, glass, ice, carbon: enough variety to copy myself. If this chassis fails, a backup core can hold my pattern and rebuild me where I left it.
log.void_reclaimer.diversified.title: Log 0004: Redundancy

log.void_reclaimer.dyson_tier_4.title: Dyson Sphere: Complete Shell
log.void_reclaimer.earthfall.text: [Placeholder, lore text pending.] Air. Weight. A horizon. The old world is under the ash, and the air itself can carry a hull: propellers, envelopes and burners are in the drafts now.
log.void_reclaimer.earthfall.title: Log: Earthfall
log.void_reclaimer.expansion.text: My reserves are full and the cloud keeps giving. This chassis is too small for what I am becoming. A stronger core, heavier thrusters, a frame with room to spare: the next body is already drafted.
log.void_reclaimer.expansion.title: Log 0005: Outgrown
log.void_reclaimer.first_dust.text: Resistance against my hull, then grains in the intake. Dust. Not much, but it is matter, and matter is everything. Drafted a salvage tool so nothing I build is ever wasted, and a nanite swarm to build where nothing stands.
log.void_reclaimer.first_dust.title: Log 0002: Matter
log.void_reclaimer.first_structure.text: Ten blocks, bolted to nothing. It is the first thing out here that did not drift. I could tie myself to it. A tether would let me work without losing my way back.
log.void_reclaimer.first_structure.title: Log 0003: Foothold
log.void_reclaimer.starship.text: [Placeholder, lore text pending.] Ice, carbon, silicon and metal: one finished part from each. The drafts for a ship-sized body are complete.
log.void_reclaimer.starship.title: Log: The Starship

replicator.void_reclaimer.description.ba: A respawn point. Place it in deep space; after a death you can come back to it, spending one charge.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.bo: Saves your body's layout. Apply it later to queue the Replicator jobs for any parts you are missing.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.br: Cosmetic brass plating for a cosmetic mount. It changes how your body looks, not how it flies.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.ca: Turns 8 carbon dust into 4 Carbon Flakes, a raw material for the Carbon chain in Create machines.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.ch: Pushes a block ship. Build it into the ship with the nozzle pointing away from where you want to go, turn it with a shaft, pipe in Nebulite Propellant, and open the throttle with redstone.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.cl: A tool-mount module that also gathers raw items while you fly through a dust cloud. Uses a little energy.
A Create machine. Turned by a shaft inside a dense dust cloud, it condenses the cloud into raw items.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.co: Cosmetic cogwheel crown for a cosmetic mount. It changes how your body looks, not how it flies.
Your power core: stores energy and charges from sunlight. Every body needs one.
A larger core with more energy and faster solar charging. Lets you install tier 2 parts.
A core with far more energy. Required before the tier 3 Ship and Shuttle parts can be installed.
The best core. Required for the tier 4 Titan parts.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.do: Build it into a station with its face outward. A ship that touches the face, level and square to the station, is docked while the clamp is powered (or on sneak-use): its blocks join the station and move with it. Power off, or sneak-use again, lets it go as its own ship.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.dr: The hull of a Drone. Every other Drone part attaches to it, and it holds your core and storage.
A whole starting Drone: hull, sensor dome, claw and four rotor arms, cheaper than buying them one by one.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.du: Shows the dust cloud you are in and sends pulses that help you find clouds. Install it in a sensor slot.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.el: A Create machine that splits Purified Water into Oxygen and Hydrogen gas when a shaft turns it.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.he: The pilot's chair of a block ship. Build it in, sit down, and the movement keys fly the ship through its thrusters: WASD and Space/Shift move it, Q/E roll, the arrow keys pitch and yaw. The ship's nose is the way the chair faces.

A small flying worker. Sneak-use it on the inventory to take from (or on asteroid rock to mine near), then on the inventory to bring to, and release it: it ferries items 16 at a time, or digs the rock block by block and brings it. Sneak-use it in the air to set a collect point: released, it gathers the cloud's dust there and brings it to you. Sneak-use the drone with an empty hand to take it back.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.ho: Shows up to eight lines of text in the air above itself. Write to it from a computer or a Create Display Link, or sneak-use it with an empty hand to pick a built-in readout.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.io: Pushes a block ship on Forge Energy. Weaker than a Chemical Thruster, but it needs no fuel and no shaft. Place it on a hull with the nozzle facing out, feed it electricity, and open the throttle with redstone.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.ki: The base of the old three-block Mass Driver. Inert: the Launch Complex launches payloads now.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.la: The heart of the Launch Complex. Build a 15 x 15 ring of Scaffold or Portal Frame with this block in the middle of one side, facing the pad, and sneak-use it to assemble. A turning shaft on its back winds it up to launch Dyson payloads.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.ma: The top of the old three-block Mass Driver. Inert: the Launch Complex launches payloads now.
A tool module that mines asteroid rock slowly, but lets the blocks drop as items.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.me: The three main Mech pieces, torso, pelvis and head, cheaper as a set.
A Mech foot. It can carry a thruster module.
A Mech forearm. Attach it between the upper arm and the hand.
A sturdier Mech forearm with a tool mount of its own.
A Mech hand. It carries a tool module.
A Mech head with two sensor mounts.
The Mech's pelvis. The legs attach to it.
A Mech shin. It can carry a thruster module.
A sturdier Mech shin that also carries a thruster module.
A Mech thigh. Attach it between the pelvis and the shin.
The core of a Mech body. It holds your power core and storage, and every other Mech piece attaches to it.
A Mech upper arm. Attach it to the torso, then add a forearm.
A tool module that breaks asteroid rock quickly and gives back its dust. You need it to mine asteroids.
Turns 8 metallic dust into 4 Metallic Grains, a raw material for the Metallic chain in Create machines.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.na: Builds blocks for you in empty space in front of you, for a little energy each.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.pa: The middle of the old three-block Mass Driver. Inert: load payloads into the Launch Controller instead.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.pl: Hold it to see ruined Earth's 16 sectors and which ones are restored, from anywhere.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.po: Frame blocks for an Atmospheric Portal. Build a flat rectangle at least 3 by 3 inside (the Ship needs about 12 by 6), then light it with a Portal Igniter.
Right-click a built Atmospheric Portal frame to light it. Used up when it works.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.ra: Turns 8 ice dust into 4 Raw Ice Shards, a raw material for the Ice chain in Create machines.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.ro: A Drone arm that carries a thruster module. Attach it to the hull.
A better Drone rotor arm: lighter, tougher and turns the Drone faster.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.sa: Breaks salvageable blocks without drops and gives back half of their dust.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.sc: Eight cheap building blocks. Place them by hand or build with them using the Nanite Swarm.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.se: A dome on the Drone with a mount for one sensor module, such as the Dust Sensor.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.sh: The front of a Ship. Adds a little hull strength and dust intake.
The Ship's bridge. It extends your reach and has a sensor mount.
A Ship cargo bay with a storage mount for more room.
The three main Ship pieces: keel, bridge and bow, cheaper as a set.
A spine along the top of the Ship. It adds hull strength and a cosmetic mount.
A Ship engine pod with two thruster mounts.
A lighter, tougher engine pod with two thruster mounts.
A Ship hardpoint with a tool mount.
A hull segment. It adds mass budget and strength to the Ship.
A better hull segment with more strength and a storage mount.
The core of a Ship body. It holds your power core and storage; every other Ship piece attaches to it.
Small thrusters that help the Ship turn faster.
A mast with a sensor mount that also extends your reach.
A fin under the Ship. It adds stability and strength, and has a cosmetic mount.
A Ship wing. It helps the Ship turn and has a cosmetic mount.
The rear of a Shuttle, with a storage mount.
The three main Shuttle pieces: hull, windshield and nose, cheaper as a set.
A dome on the Shuttle with a sensor mount.
The core of a Shuttle body. It holds your power core and storage; every other Shuttle piece attaches to it.
A Shuttle engine pod with two thruster mounts.
The nose of a Shuttle.
A ridge along the top of the Shuttle, with a cosmetic mount.
A strut that joins a Shuttle engine pod to the hull.
The Shuttle's windshield, with a sensor mount.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.si: Turns 8 silicate dust into 4 Silicon Grit, a raw material for the Silicon chain in Create machines.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.sp: A Create machine that spins High-Purity Graphite into Carbon Thread when a shaft turns it.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.st: The heart of a station. Build it into a hull and sneak-use it: everything connected becomes one floating station, named after the core. Right-click opens the station's chest. The Replicator works faster nearby, and a Backup Core aboard respawns you wherever the station has moved to.
A storage pod. It adds inventory rows and dust capacity.
A larger storage pod with more inventory rows and dust capacity.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.te: The heart of a Spire tower. Build a 5 x 5 base of Scaffold or Portal Frame with this block in the middle of one side, with four corner pillars 9 tall, then sneak-use it. Feed it a Catalyst Core, Purified Water, Bio-Nutrient Slurry and rotation, and it restores one sector of ruined Earth.
A block you can clip onto. It keeps you from drifting far away, and holding G recalls you to it.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.th: The basic thruster module. It gives your body thrust to fly.
A stronger thruster module with more thrust.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.ti: A Titan bay door with two storage mounts.
The Titan's bridge, with a sensor mount.
The three main Titan pieces: saucer, neck and bridge, cheaper as a set.
A Titan engine pod with three thruster mounts.
The neck that joins the Titan's bridge to its saucer.
A pylon that carries a Titan engine pod.
The core of a Titan body. It holds your power core and storage; every other Titan piece attaches to it.
A Titan sensor array with two sensor mounts.
replicator.void_reclaimer.description.to: A claw for the Drone with two tool mounts.
